Stated Claim / Post Context:
Burnham says Iran’s IRGC likely behind Fairford incident

U.K. Prime Minister Burnham said Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps was likely behind an incident at RAF Fairford. The base had been used by U.S. bombers to strike Iran; last week, President Donald Trump said a threat linked to Iran had prompted the planes’ removal.
